subject.title: refactor(memory): move QMD coordination to SQLite

question: Should this release make `runtime.state.withLease` a supported public plugin API and use a restart-only QMD cutover with no mixed-version compatibility path?
rationale: The branch changes a public plugin contract, persisted agent schema, backup semantics, and upgrade behavior; code review can assess implementation quality, but only an owner can accept that permanent API and operator boundary.

options.title: Approve after proof
options.body: Keep the generic lease API and restart-only cutover, then merge after the topology gate and real upgrade/backup proof are clean.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Keep QMD on SQLite leases but redesign the host seam so it does not establish a general third-party plugin API in this release.

options.title: Defer the cutover
options.body: Retain the shipped file-lock behavior until a later release can provide a different compatibility or rollout plan.

recommendation.title: Approve after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the generic lease API and restart-only cutover, then merge after the topology gate and real upgrade/backup proof are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows the strongest recent ownership across QMD runtime structure, database-first work, and this proposed host contract.
